Step 1: Determine offsets.  
Europe/Paris is UTC+1 (standard time).  
US/Eastern is UTC-5 (standard time).  

Step 2: Convert Paris time to UTC.  
8:00 Paris (UTC+1) → UTC = 8:00 − 1 = 07:00 UTC.

Step 3: Convert UTC to US/Eastern.  
07:00 UTC → US/Eastern = 07:00 − 5 = 02:00 same date.

Step 4: No date change needed (02:00 earlier same day).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 02:00
